name: guppi-gpt-web
description: The GuppiGPT page: bundled once with esbuild into dist/

scripts.build: esbuild src/app.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/app.js && esbuild src/flags.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/flags.js && esbuild src/approve.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/approve.js && esbuild src/sandbox/frame.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/sandbox/frame.js && cp src/index.html src/app.css src/privacy.html src/terms.html src/flags.html src/approve.html src/projects.json dist/ && cp src/sandbox/frame.html dist/sandbox/
